reading_note: The teaching describes the complete arc of regeneration as a five-staged elevation. The "Five Awakeners / Drawers-upward" are the five discrete degrees by which the Lord raises a soul from spiritual death (immersion in worldly desire and self-love) into resurrection-life. The arc moves from the outermost awakening of the natural mind, through interior degrees, up to the Mind of Light (celestial perception) and finally to the Good itself (love to the Lord). Each degree gathers, conforms to its own image, and gives rest. The whole process is named in many tongues — Peace, Stillness, the Fast, the Day, the Rest, the Father — all designating the same regenerate state. The Pillar of Glory is the column of accumulated truth on which souls ascend forever in the Great Aeon.
